title: fix(google): Gemini 3.8 Live never replies when the microphone sends digital-zero silence (audioStreamEnd stalls the turn)
body:
Closes #152830

**No longer stacked.** #152413 and #152680 have both merged into main, so this branch is now the single commit `fix(google): keep streaming silence to Gemini 3.8 Live instead of ending the audio stream` rebased onto main (a1287689a3f): +8 source in `realtime-voice-model-contract.ts`, a net −1 line in `realtime-voice-provider.ts`, and +26 tests. It uses #152413's 3.8 model classifier, which is now on main.

### What Problem This Solves

On `gemini-3.8-live` and `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking`, a client that sends exact-zero audio when the user stops talking never gets a reply. After 500 ms of exact-zero frames, `GoogleRealtimeVoiceBridge.sendAudio` sends `audioStreamEnd` and drops further silent frames. Gemini 3.1 treats `audioStreamEnd` as the end of the user's turn. Gemini 3.8 ignores it, and its server VAD only detects the end of speech while trailing audio keeps arriving. So the turn never completes, no reply comes, and the user's transcript shows up only when they speak again, merged into that next utterance.

### User Impact

Talk and other Google realtime voice clients on Gemini 3.8 Live get replies even when their microphone sends digital-zero silence: a muted or gated microphone, a digitally silent audio leg, or a synthetic or headless driver. Ordinary microphones were not affected, because their noise floor never counts as silence. Gemini 3.1 and older models keep the existing audio-stream-end behavior.

### Why This Change Was Made

Isolated on the raw Live API on 2026-09-19, with the same speech in every run ([README](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/README.md), [probe](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/probe/probe_input_tx.py)):

| after speech, the client… | 3.8 Live | 3.8 Live Extended Thinking | 3.1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| keeps sending zero frames | 3/3 turns complete | 3/3 | – |
| sends 500 ms of zeros, then `audioStreamEnd`, then nothing (the bridge today) | **0/3** | **0/3** | 3/3 |
| sends 500 ms of zeros, then nothing | **0/3** | **0/3** | – |

On 3.8 the stall comes from stopping the audio stream, whether or not `audioStreamEnd` is sent. The fix is therefore a model contract: a new `endsTurnOnAudioStreamEnd(model)` (false for 3.8). When it is false, `sendAudio` forwards every frame and never ends the stream. On 3.8 the bridge now streams silence the way a real microphone already does. The two post-send `if (!silent)` branches are merged, which keeps the over-cap provider file from growing.

### Evidence


**Final maintainer verification:** reviewed head `22a7cb066289e45bad2a820323fc74810ce0979a`. [CI run 36491801517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36491801517) succeeded for this head's synthetic merge; the relevant Google-plugin shard passed 37 files / 713 tests, including the two silent-frame regressions. Final source/architecture review and independent structured review through P3 found no actionable defects; `git diff --check` passed. The change stays in the existing Google model contract and bridge, with other models' stream-end policy unchanged.

**Landing status:** merged via squash as [2a7642919ecc445f59e39d636171ee39267f327e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a7642919ecc445f59e39d636171ee39267f327e) through the documented native completed-evidence path. Existing exact-head CI and Workflow Sanity were verified without reruns, a head change, an admin exception, or changes to merge safeguards.

**Evidence scope:** the live recordings below prove the production bridge on earlier revisions, not the complete current-head runtime. The silence-forwarding fix is unchanged, but inherited runtime code has changed since those recordings. No new local test suite, live Gemini API run, or full Gateway/device run was performed during this maintainer review. The fix forwards silence supplied by the client; it does not synthesize frames when the client stops sending. Continuous-silence traffic and the minimum VAD tail were not measured.


**Changed-runtime proof: the production Google bridge against the live API**, created the way the Gateway relay creates it (PCM16 24 kHz). It speaks three utterances with exact-zero frames in between ([driver](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge/input-transcript-proof-driver.mts), `MIC_SILENCE=zeros`).

| model | before (#152680 head, 87ed0f9fdd4) | after (this PR, 91eb5a9986c) |
|---|---|---|
| gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking | **0/3** replies; one late user transcript merging utterances 1 and 2 ([log](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge/zeros-g38et.jsonl)) | 3/3 replies, 3 user finals, in 3 runs ([1](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/zeros-g38et.jsonl), [2](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/zeros-g38et-2.jsonl), [3](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/zeros-g38et-3.jsonl)) |
| gemini-3.8-live | **0/3** ([log](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge/zeros-g38.jsonl)) | 3/3 ([log](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/zeros-g38.jsonl)) |
| gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview (unchanged path) | 3/3 ([log](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge/zeros-g31.jsonl)) | 3/3 ([log](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/zeros-g31.jsonl)) |

Re-run on the head rebased onto main 80e7d21dda5 (9d8bf63d961, `MIC_SILENCE=zeros`; the then-current head 69b1ac71d88 was that tree restacked on #152413's docs-only wording fix, so those two historical revisions had byte-identical runtime code): 3/3 replies and 3 user finals on both 3.8 models ([extended thinking](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/rebased-on-80e7d21dda5/zeros-g38et.jsonl), [3.8](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge-after/rebased-on-80e7d21dda5/zeros-g38.jsonl)).

Restack 2026-09-28 (22a7cb06628, cherry-picked onto main a1287689a3f with no conflicts; the diff is byte-identical to 69b1ac71d88): `vitest run extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.test.ts extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.gemini38.test.ts` → 84 passed; `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base origin/main` passes the conflict-marker, line-cap and max-lines ratchets. Its env-var-count budget step fails on this head and on untouched main alike (477 vs budget 476, nothing in this diff touches `OPENCLAW_*`).

Test cost (AGENTS.md test budget): the three new or changed cases in `extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.gemini38.test.ts` use the existing fake-bridge fixture with no timers, sleeps, polling, process boots, serial config, or worker pins. Local `pnpm test extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.gemini38.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` on head 22a7cb06628: 14 tests, vitest Duration 3.55 s, 5.49 s wall. CI on the same head ([checks-node-changed-extensions-config](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36491801517/job/109162649761), 3 min 08 s job, shard 37 files / 713 tests / 87.84 s): `ends the audio stream on silence only for models that end the turn on audioStreamEnd` 1 ms, `keeps forwarding silent microphone frames to gemini-3.8-live instead of ending the audio stream` 3 ms, `keeps forwarding silent microphone frames to gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking instead of ending the audio stream` 1 ms.

Control: with a ±8 LSB noise floor instead of zeros, every model answered 3/3 before the fix ([noise-g38et](https://github.com/saariuslystoned/openclaw/blob/proof/gemini38-input-transcripts-20260919/proof/audio-stream-end-silence/bridge/noise-g38et.jsonl)). One after-run on Extended Thinking also logged a routine server `goAway` (300 s left). The provider already reports this as `onError`, the session continued to a clean close, and the two reruns saw none.

- `vitest run extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.test.ts extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.gemini38.test.ts extensions/google/thinking.test.ts` → 121 passed. The existing 3.1 test "marks the Google audio stream complete after sustained telephony silence" is unchanged and passes. The two new 3.8 bridge tests fail against the previous `sendAudio` (2 failed / 11 passed in the 3.8 file).
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` is clean, and `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base <#152680 head>` exits 0. The line-cap ratchet shows `realtime-voice-provider.ts` shrinking by one counted line.

Not measured: the fix streams silence continuously, the same traffic a live microphone already produces. I did not measure how much trailing silence 3.8's VAD needs.
